narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think a pattern is only a list of numbers, so the Sun cannot be one.
<bookmark mark='look'/>But day and night come back in order, and there is no number in them.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Something can repeat by a rule without any number at all.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>A pattern is something that repeats or grows by a rule.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Name one more pattern you see at home or on your street.
